grade.answer_reason: The answer covers every point the label requires. Thistlewire 0.9 server streams have no flow control and queue without bound because max_buffered_messages defaults to 0 (unlimited). It recommends setting a cap and says that at the cap the stream closes with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, so dashboards must reconnect. It also notes the fact comes from the 0.9 docs and matches the pinned 0.9.4.
